roadmap.title: Bunker basics and Prologue
roadmap.description: Finish the Prologue, then die once, kill an enemy and craft an item.

roadmap.title: Forest and early Barman quests
roadmap.description: Beat Lazar, help Igor and take early quests; buy Milk daily.

roadmap.title: Camp, Industrial Area, Swamp and Mall
roadmap.description: Clear Orel, Arman, Voss, Rotking and Phantom, reach the Mall and open Zakov.

roadmap.title: Zakov, army factions and Barman finale
roadmap.description: Finish the Mall and Zakov quests, pick an army faction and reach the plant.

roadmap.title: Endgame bosses and secret ending
roadmap.description: Finish Unknown quests, beat the Outer Deity, then the secret ending.

roadmap.title: Long grinds and challenges
roadmap.description: Counters, money, skills, factions, second playthrough and the permadeath run.

steps.text: Kill any enemy in a raid.

guide.context: After a death you return to the @npc{Trainman} with your inventory restored.

steps.text: Go on a raid and die to an enemy or hazard.
Die in raids until your death count reaches 100.
Open a crafting station in the @loc{Bunker} and craft any item, such as drinkable water from irradiated water.

guide.context: Quests come from the @npc{Barman}, the @npc{Doctor}, the @npc{General} and the @npc{Trainman}.

steps.text: Accept quests from the quest givers at the @loc{Bunker} and turn in 10 of them.
Open containers while looting raids until the count reaches 50.
Hunt animals on any map until 50 are dead.
Repair damaged weapons and armour with repair kits or the Workshop until you have done 50 repairs.
Keep killing enemies across raids until the total reaches 1000.

achievements.description: Defeat a big for the first time
achievements.summary: Kill your first Big, a large mutant.

guide.context: A Big has 370 HP and charges, then stands still.

steps.text: Find a Big in the Mall, the Swamp, Industrial Area buildings or the end of the Laboratory.
Kill it: about 5 close shotgun blasts or many rifle shots.
Finish the Mall quests up to @mechanic{The bridge to Zakov}, which repairs the power grid.
Cross the bridge from the @loc{Mall} into @loc{Zakov}.
Travel to maps with the @npc{Trainman} until you have boarded 100 times.

achievements.description: Complete all of the Barman’s quests
achievements.summary: Complete all of the Barman's quests.

guide.context: Includes @mechanic{Stylish one p.2}: kill Kibba 15 times in the Mall.

steps.text: Keep taking and finishing the @npc{Barman}'s quests until none are left, ending with @mechanic{What next?}.

achievements.summary: Complete the Barman's quest Radiation effect by reaching the orange radiation level.

guide.context: Orange level is 5.00 or higher and causes bleeding.

steps.text: Take @mechanic{Radiation effect} from the @npc{Barman}.
Raise radiation: stand where the screen turns to white noise, such as near big trucks, or drink rotten water.
Bandage the bleeding, then return to the Barman.
Buy from or sell to traders until you have made 50 trades.
Hunt ghouls in @loc{Zakov} until 100 are dead.

achievements.summary: Defeat Lazar, the boss of the Forest.

guide.context: Lazar stays near the police station with four guards.

steps.text: Go to the village at the center of the @loc{Forest} and find the police station.
Pick off the guards from range first; this usually draws @enemy{Lazar} out.
Kill @enemy{Lazar}.

achievements.displayName: Can I Speak to the Manager?
achievements.description: Kill Kibba, the boss who guards the Mall.
achievements.summary: Kill Kibba, the boss who guards the Mall.

guide.context: Kibba chases hard and fires a PRK 16 from a large drum magazine.

steps.text: Unlock the @loc{Mall} through the @npc{Barman}'s quests.
Find @enemy{Kibba} in the center of the @loc{Mall}, around the GUNS store or the food court.
Kill him.

achievements.description: Defeat Arman in the Makeshift Camp.
achievements.summary: Defeat Arman, the boss of the Makeshift Camp.

guide.context: Arman has no fixed spot and ambushes. Suppressed gunfire or corpses with no clear killer show he is near.

steps.text: Search the @loc{Makeshift Camp} until you find @enemy{Arman}.
Shoot him first if you can; he takes cover to reload.
Find hidden stashes in raids and loot 10 of them.

guide.context: Do not kill Igor, even if the General asks.

steps.text: Find @npc{Igor}'s fenced house in the @loc{Forest}.
Bring 2 Medikit T-000, 4 Bandages and 10 Raw meat.
Take @mechanic{Revenge for Igor} and kill Private Bogdanov.

achievements.description: Litter the ground with 1000 bullets in one raid
achievements.summary: Fire 1000 bullets in a single raid.

guide.context: The bullets count as shots fired, not dropped ammo.

steps.text: Buy about 1000 rounds and bring a fast automatic weapon at full durability.
In one raid, fire all of them without leaving.

achievements.description: Complete the game with permadeath enabled
achievements.summary: Finish the game on a save with permadeath turned on.

guide.context: Dying ends that save. Difficulty settings can lower enemy health and damage; enemy grenades still kill.

steps.text: Begin a fresh save, switch permadeath on, and pick easier difficulty settings.
Finish the story without dying.

achievements.displayName: All that for a Drop of Blood
achievements.summary: Heal bleeding or HP while at 10 HP or less.

steps.text: Get down to 10 HP or less in a raid.
Use a bandage or medkit to heal.

achievements.description: Reach maximum relationship with any faction
achievements.summary: Reach maximum relationship with any faction.

guide.context: Relations start at 300; kills lower them. Trading with a faction trader adds 1 point per 20000 Roubles.

steps.text: Pick one faction and finish its leader's quests.
Buy and sell with its trader.
Do Networker tasks for it.

guide.context: Higher trader money and sale prices in the difficulty settings make this faster.

steps.text: Sell loot and quest rewards while saving Roubles until you hold 1,000,000 at once.

achievements.description: Hold less than 10 Roubles at once
achievements.summary: Have under 10 Roubles on you at one time.

steps.text: Spend or store your Roubles until you carry under 10.

guide.context: A Blink is fast and bites for heavy damage with bleeding, so keep bandages ready.

steps.text: Hunt Blinks in @loc{Zakov} until 182 are dead.
Take a daily mission from the @npc{Networker}.
Finish it and turn it in; repeat until you have 5.

achievements.summary: Fill your inventory completely with milk.

guide.context: The Barman sells 2 Milk a day at 800 Roubles each, and shop stock resets at 7:30 am.

steps.text: Buy all Milk from the @npc{Barman} every day.
Keep it in your inventory until it is full.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum level for pistols.

steps.text: Use pistols in raids so the skill levels up until it reaches its maximum.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum level for SMGs.

steps.text: Use SMGs in raids so the skill levels up until it reaches its maximum.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum level for shotguns.

steps.text: Use shotguns in raids so the skill levels up until it reaches its maximum.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum level for rifles.

steps.text: Use rifles in raids so the skill levels up until it reaches its maximum.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum level for DMRs.

steps.text: Use DMRs in raids so the skill levels up until it reaches its maximum.

achievements.summary: Reach the maximum level for sniper rifles.

steps.text: Use sniper rifles in raids so the skill levels up until it reaches its maximum.
Play through the Prologue until it ends.

achievements.summary: Complete the quest Get some Music.

steps.text: Take the quest @mechanic{Get some Music} and finish its objectives.

achievements.description: Play your first track on the radio
achievements.summary: Play a track on the radio for the first time.

steps.text: Once the radio quest unlocks the radio, play any track on it in the @loc{Bunker}.

achievements.description: Fill any container to 1000+ of a single item
achievements.summary: Put 1000 or more of a single item into one container.

guide.context: Loot settings can make ammo drop in packs up to 999.

steps.text: Collect one item type, such as ammo, and store 1000 or more of it in one container.
Get a train skin from the @npc{Conductor}.

guide.context: Skins carry over between saves. One playthrough gives 4 or 5, depending on the ending.

steps.text: Unlock skins in one playthrough; it gives 4 or 5 of the six, depending on the ending.
Start a second playthrough and join the Green Army to unlock the rest.

guide.context: You can join only one army faction per save, so this and the Green Army questline need separate playthroughs.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{New arrivals} to unlock @npc{Reynard Shepard}.
Join Crimson Corporation and finish all of his quests, ending with @mechanic{The War}.

achievements.description: Defeat Orel, leader of the Makeshift Camp
achievements.summary: Defeat Orel, the leader of the Makeshift Camp.

guide.context: Orel is at the far west of the Train station area with several bandits.

steps.text: Take the Barman's quest @mechanic{Clear the way}.
Enter the @loc{Makeshift Camp} train station and take a side path, not the middle.
Kill the bandits, then @enemy{Orel}.

achievements.summary: Defeat Voss, the commander of Horizon.

guide.context: Horizon appears in Industrial Area after you accept the Barman's @mechanic{Any news?} quest.

steps.text: Go to the north-east docks of the @loc{Industrial Area}.
Kill @enemy{Commander Voss}, who chases fast.

achievements.description: Defeat the Devil in the Parking Lot
achievements.summary: Defeat the Devil in the Mall's parking lot.

guide.context: The Devil spawns in the Mall basement only after @mechanic{Clear the way, again} or @mechanic{A new Devil}.

steps.text: Complete either @mechanic{Clear the way, again} or @mechanic{A new Devil}.
Go to the @loc{Mall} basement and kill @enemy{Devil} (100 HP, class 6 armor).

guide.context: Valentine roams with 5 to 6 guards.

steps.text: Search @loc{Zakov} near the school, the park and west of the police station.
Kill @enemy{Valentine} and his guards.

guide.context: The @npc{Doctor} is the Scientists' trader.

steps.text: Raise Scientists reputation, for example by trading with the @npc{Doctor}, until it reaches 450.

guide.context: You can join only one army faction per save, so this and the Crimson Corporation questline need separate playthroughs.

steps.text: Finish @mechanic{Clear the way} to unlock @npc{General Artemovich}.
Join the Green Army and finish all of his quests, ending with @mechanic{The War}.

achievements.description: Defeat the Phantom of the Swamp
achievements.summary: Defeat the Phantom in the Swamp.

guide.context: The Phantom roams the surface in a ghillie suit and blends in.

steps.text: Search the @loc{Swamp} surface for @enemy{Phantom}.
Kill him.

guide.context: There is no journal entry for this step. The binary on Unknown's documents spells the word you type.

steps.text: Finish the Barman's quests and Unknown's quests.
Enter the Watchers HQ in @loc{Zakov} and reach the purple crystal at the end.
Pick no dialogue option; type @item{stalker}.

achievements.description: Own each of the Bosses' unique armors
achievements.summary: Own the unique armor of every boss.

guide.context: Armor drops are not guaranteed; fight a boss again in a later raid if it does not drop.

collectibles.name: Lazar's armor
collectibles.location: @loc{Forest}: Outside the police station in the village.
collectibles.method: Kill Lazar and take his armor; it does not always drop.

collectibles.name: Arman's armor
collectibles.location: @loc{Makeshift Camp}: Roams the whole map; no fixed spot.
collectibles.method: Kill Arman and take the Arman suit.

collectibles.name: Orel's armor
collectibles.location: @loc{Makeshift Camp}: Far west of the train station area.
collectibles.method: Kill Orel; his armor only drops with the NPCs drop armor setting on.

collectibles.name: Commander Voss's armor
collectibles.method: Kill Voss and take the Commander Voss suit.

collectibles.name: Rotking's armor
collectibles.location: @loc{Swamp}: Sewer laboratory area, before the valve.
collectibles.method: Kill Rotking and take the Rotking Armor.

collectibles.name: Phantom's armor
collectibles.method: Kill the Phantom and take the ghillie suit.

collectibles.name: Kibba's armor
collectibles.method: Take Kibba Armor as the reward for Stylish one p.1.

collectibles.name: Devil's armor
collectibles.method: Kill the Devil; his armor drops rarely.

collectibles.name: Valentine's armor
collectibles.method: Kill Valentine and check what he drops.

achievements.description: Defeat Rotking, who hides in the Sewers
achievements.summary: Defeat Rotking in the Swamp sewers.

guide.context: Rotking is in the laboratory area, right before the valve.

steps.text: Get the sewer key through the main quest.
Enter the @loc{Swamp} sewers and reach the laboratory area.
Kill @enemy{Rotking}.
Take the note from @enemy{Phantom}'s body.
Follow it to the stash and loot it.
Search the sewers of the @loc{Makeshift Camp} for @npc{Mr. Junk}'s hideout and talk to him.

guide.context: Bring the Psy Helmet, plenty of ammo and a high-capacity gun.

steps.text: Finish @npc{Unknown}'s quests The Psy Helmet p.1 and p.2 to get the Psy Helmet, then take @mechanic{Outer Deity}.
Keep the Psy Helmet in your inventory.
Go to the @loc{Swamp} village and touch the violet crystal.
In the white space, dodge the homing crystals by running in circles and kill the Outer Deity.

guide.context: Unknown's quests: The Psy Helmet p.1 and p.2, Outer Deity, Revelations.

steps.text: Meet @npc{Unknown} in the @loc{Swamp} sewers after the Barman's @mechanic{The crystal}.
Finish all four of his quests in order.

achievements.description: Travel to the Nuclear Power Plant
achievements.summary: Travel to the Nuclear Power Plant.

steps.text: Take the Barman's @mechanic{What next?} quest.
Go through the Watchers HQ in @loc{Zakov} and follow the railroad marked Towards Nuclear Facility.
Reach the crystal anomaly through the Watchers HQ route.
Look for the Inner Deity there and kill it.
